tool_suggestions.title: User Subscription Management Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard for Delphi.ai employees to efficiently manage and track user subscriptions. This tool should support actions like updating subscription details, tracking payment history, and managing billing cycles.
features: Subscription overview with filters for status and plan type
Edit user subscription details and billing cycles
View user payment history and upcoming renewals
Alerts for subscriptions nearing expiry without auto-renew
Downloadable reports for billing and renewals

tool_suggestions.title: AI Clone Performance Insight Tool
tool_suggestions.prompt: Design a tool for Delphi.ai to visualize and analyze AI clone performance metrics. This includes tracking training status, user interactions, and feedback to improve product quality.
features: Dashboard with real-time clone performance and status
Detailed analytics on user interactions and satisfaction ratings
Historical trend comparison for clone interactions and feedback
Alerts for clones with low average ratings
Export reports of interaction and performance analytics

tool_suggestions.title: Content Processing and Error Resolution Queue
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a queue management tool to help Delphi.ai staff handle content processing jobs. This tool should track processing status, report errors, and allow updates on job statuses.
features: Queue view for pending content processing jobs with filters
Error log and resolution actions for failed jobs
Update and track job statuses from pending to complete
Exportable logs for auditing content processing activities
